entries.title: Operator web application
entries.summary: The localhost Deal Card and New Lead workflow are the owner-facing completion authority.

entries.title: Canonical LandOS records
entries.summary: Deal, property, seller, evidence, comp, visual, document, market, valuation, and workflow state remain in LandOS stores and APIs.

entries.title: Bounded research workers
entries.summary: Hermes workers return validated property-scoped handbacks; only LandOS may admit them to canonical state.

entries.title: Separated governed roles
entries.summary: Research, visual QA, debugging, knowledge, and automation use isolated authority boundaries; implementers cannot certify their own work.

entries.title: Independent visual acceptance
entries.summary: Playwright evidence packages support an independent visual PASS or FAIL and a non-destructive completion gate.

entries.title: Local operating knowledge
entries.summary: Repository Markdown and validated registries store architecture and operating knowledge while referencing canonical records by identifier or path.
